title: WeekModel reports child rows despite being a flat list
environment: Production QML-registered WeekModel, Qt 6.12.0 MSVC 2022 x64; Qt Quick Test offscreen with isolated test setup.
reproduction_status: Confirmed through the actual model's invokable rowCount/index methods. Top-level rowCount is seven; rowCount(index(0, 0)) is incorrectly seven as well.
reproduction: Create WeekModel and verify rowCount() is seven.
Obtain its valid first-row index with index(0, 0).
Call rowCount with that index as parent; observe seven instead of zero.
expected: Root has seven day rows; valid row indexes have zero child rows, consistent with the non-hierarchical QAbstractListModel contract.
source: weekmodel.cpp: WeekModel::rowCount ignores its parent argument.
impact: Confirmed Qt model-contract inconsistency. Current Weekdays Repeater consumes top-level rows; no visible shopping-screen failure, data loss or Android-specific impact was established.

regression.before: Two fixture records pass; the observable child-row assertion fails with actual seven versus expected zero.
regression.permanent_test_required: Completed; permanent case and before/after results are recorded in resolution.

implementation_scope: Only WeekModel::rowCount valid-parent handling and permanent QTest regression/documentation. Reset/refresh/timer changes remain separate.

resolution.change: Return zero for valid parents; preserve seven root rows.
resolution.before: Permanent test added first: two fixtures pass, assertion fails with seven children instead of zero.
resolution.after: Focused case passes; final normal model suite contains the passing regression among 66 records.

verification.final_test_adjustment: After const-correctness cleanup in the new fixture, rebuilt and reran the final 66-record model suite; production sources unchanged from full UI/flow/keyboard run.
verification.limits: Pure model-contract fix; no new Android/visual certification. Reset/date-refresh candidates remain separate.

resolution.commit: Committed with this ticket's source changes and permanent regression tests; see Git history and DEV-006 closure.
